segments.title: Scores between words
segments.learningGoal: Each word scores every other word; a row of weights sums to one.
segments.visualPlan: Matrix: query words down, key words across, heat by weight.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How does the word it know that it means the brick?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Each word scores every other word. In this example it gives brick a weight of 0.81 and fell only 0.07.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the row for it is mostly brick, and the row sums to one?
